name: Sudden Speed
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 2, inquisitor 2, paladin 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Duration 1 round + 1 round/3 levels

DESCRIPTION

With a practiced motion you complete this spell and gain a burst of speed that briefly aids you in combat.

You gain a 10 foot increase to your base movement speed as well as a +1 bonus to armor class and reflex saves for one round plus one round per three caster levels you possess.
